newsitem.title: FRANCE: Traxon Europe announces top management changes.
newsitem.headline: Traxon Europe announces top management changes.

text.p: Air France Cargo's Claude Sereno, has stood down as chairman of Traxon Europe, the European arm of airfreight information system, effective January 1, the company said in a statement.
Sereno is replaced by Manfred Wekwerth, previously head of computer services at Lufthansa Cargo.
Christian Gillard, previously Air France Cargo's general manager in Brazil, replaces Hans-Peter Treibel as Traxon's managing director marketing sales.
Treibel is to return to Lufthansa Cargo.
Both Sereno and Treibel joined Traxon Europe in 1991, the year the company was founded.
Air France and Lufthansa are the principal shareholders in Traxon Europe. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 5017
